preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of edges E must be between 0 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: All vertices in the adjacency list must be valid and within the range of 0 to V-1.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of sorted safe nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(node in safe_nodes for node in terminal_nodes)
postconditions.description: All terminal nodes must be included in the safe nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(node not in safe_nodes for node in unsafe_nodes)
postconditions.description: No unsafe nodes must be included in the safe nodes.
